mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the FEDFUNDS rate above 4% in a month triggers a term premium compression, reducing expected equity discount and pushing 20-day S&P 500 forward returns negative.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above 4% in a single month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS > 4%, or term premium change is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly PAYEMS (labor market strength) combined with falling UNRATE (wage growth slowing) creates a divergence that predicts positive S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases while UNRATE decreases over the same month
regime_hint: labor market strengthening with wage moderation
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not statistically outperforming a baseline model (p > 0.05) or proxies move in the opposite direction.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly surge in HOUST (industrial production) above the prior 3 months' average, in the absence of a concurrent CPIAUCSL inflation spike, signals a demand recovery and positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 3-month moving average and CPIAUCSL < 3-month moving average
failure_condition: 20-day returns underperform a no-signal baseline (p > 0.05) or inflation is the dominant driver.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO (industrial production) for two consecutive months predicts a supply shock, resulting in negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not statistically negative (p > 0.05) or INDPRO recovers before 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS remains below 2% for three consecutive months, the low-rate environment supports higher equity valuations, producing positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns underperform a high-rate benchmark (p < 0.05) or FEDFUNDS rises before 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE below 6% combined with a decline in PAYEMS suggests wage moderation and weak labor demand, forecasting negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
regime_hint: wage suppression and labor market softening
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) or proxies move in the opposite direction.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly falls in RSAFS (commercial loan growth) exceeding -2% indicate credit contraction, which precedes negative 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not statistically negative (p > 0.05) or RSAFS recovers before 60 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in UNRATE above 7% combined with a decline in FEDFUNDS suggests a policy shift toward higher rates, compressing equity valuations and producing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 7% while FEDFUNDS falls in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) or policy shift is not confirmed by other indicators.
